chapter: Ellington, singers, the book and closing
title: Not a pimp: Diane, the police brothel and Bellevue
summary: He insists he could not be a pimp and ties his Bellevue stay to Diane, a call girl.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Anything else that was left out of the book that you wish had been there?
Well, (unintelligible) I wasn't a pimp. That that really said I was solid against pimps. I got to clear that up. That I couldn't be a pimp.
Why?
Religious fear or whatever you want to call it.
Character.
That's why I went to Bellevue that time.
Yeah. Why was that connected with your going to Bellevue?
Well, you remember Diane?
Yeah.
Well, Diane was a call girl.
Right.
She wasn't -- I made her be a call -- I turned her out.
Yeah.
And she was in with the police chiefs who own these -- they had a extravagant whorehouse in the '80s.
And if that was hot that night, you'd get a phone call and they've move to Second Avenue somewhere.
Yeah.
And I found out the police were all behind it. I don't know if I answered your question.
So that discovery -- how did that connect with going to the Bellevue?
She got a date to go to Acapulco.
Yeah.
And I realized I was moving into being Big Time Bill.
All she had was a picture of a guy, she was going to wait til she saw him, ignore all the other guys that made advances. But she was a very pretty girl when she was young.
Yeah.
And he was supposed to come in and make bets. She knew all this. That he could get this girl that nobody could get.
Yeah.
And then they'd all ball her. I forgot -- there was a great deal of money she was supposed to get guaranteed from the madam, plus what she got from them. So I asked her not to go.
Yeah.
And she wouldn't listen. That's the same I went to Bellevue on. Plus I was writing music for John Cassavettes then.
Oh, --
I hadn't slept.
Yeah.
And I took a whole lot of . I took about nine and went to sleep. Plus a couple of Valiums, and wine.
